text.text_excerpt: Bywater is one of those neighborhoods we had never explored before but always heard about. A friend of a friend recommended Elizabeth's and on our last day in town we figured it was worth exploring a bit. It was a Tuesday so no wait which was nice. Elizabeth's is eclectically designed with memorabilia all over from New Orleans past. The hostess and waitress were super nice and personable. They have a board with specials and the pecan waffle caught my eye immediately. After reading on Yelp about the praline bacon I had to get that, as well. The waffle was mind-blowingly good. The homemade whipped cream made it even better. The praline bacon is NO JOKE. So good, not sticky whatsoever, and f...

Came here for breakfast while in NOLA for a bachelor party. There were eight of us and we were seated promptly. We were recommend this place by a girlfriend of one of our party. We all ordered our Bloody Marys and looked over the menu. Half of us ordered the catfish, two of us ordered the duck waffle entree, and I ordred the eggs florentine. It took a while for the food to come out, but the service was attentive and our drinks were always full. The food was absolutely incredible. The eggs florentine contained the absolute best poached egg I've ever had the pleasure of eating along with the best fried oysters I've had in an extremely long time. The creamed spinach was also very good. Every...

There's nothing more than brunch that I love. Maybe some other things like life and breath, but brunch is up there. While visiting my friends we stopped here on my last day. The place is adorable and eclectic just as NOLA offers itself to be. Great artwork available for purchase on the walls. Place was clean, service was great and coffee was strong and flowing. We shared eggs Benedict with fried green tomato and grits, sausage gravy and biscuit and praline bacon. The Stars aligned, everyone's worlds collided when bacon and a praline mated. Oh is it lovely.
